receipt_plan.detail: Add or run a securityDefaults test asserting MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth == 500; the changed line fails it. Ledger [L9] records the stack depth limit of 500 as deliberate secure-by-default behavior.

findings.claim: Dropping diagnostics for metadata-only types and documenting that their defining assemblies own member validation is deliberate product behavior, not a regression in the crash fix.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] records that referenced-assembly types are deliberately not analyzed by the consuming compilation and receive no formatter or MsgPack003/004/005 diagnostics there; the defining assembly owns validation and formatting.
